tool_args.rationale: The paid measurements show positive short-horizon response and negative response at H=13.82 and 19.2, matching endogenous dual-timescale adaptation. Fit its four parameters numerically to all eight rows; the predict function uses stored fit parameters and does not refit from a single row.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Not needed to identify this law: the long-horizon observations establish reversal and the supplied dual-horizon mechanism is directly fit by the existing rows.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a static gain or one-timescale relaxation law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: These cannot explain the observed sign change from positive short horizons to negative long horizons.
Its trajectory-state requirements are absent; the observed horizon-dependent reversal is specifically captured by the simpler dual-horizon law.
